What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Veers (V)]]: left, the image of [[Veers (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit a5142dd); right, the image of [[Veers (V) (Errata 2)]] (holotable commit 649630f). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a5142dd7418713cff839446994555bb787c156b4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/649630ff80dd241d266f2ee5b566324d6fb68448/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual6-Dark/large/veers.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
